title: Calligram outline sheet: a mountain peak
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 41 (Calligram outline sheet: a mountain peak (printable or on a drawing tablet))
intro: Lesson 41: Calligrams: drafting a shape poem of a peak. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: What is a calligram?
points: The words make the shape of the subject
Read it by following the shape

head: Part of the shape
Line
Example
rows: wrapped in a scarf of drifting cloud
where green fields and gurgling streams begin

parts.text: Base: standing guard over the sleeping valley.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Four lines that get longer, ready to shape into a mountain

keywords.def: a poem where the words make a picture of the subject
how the words are placed on the page

questions.q: Write a base line of eight or more words
questions.a: For example: where yaks graze beside the gurgling stream below

questions.q: Core: draft your one-verse poem (four to six lines) and write it on the mountain outline so the shape shows
Extend: read your poem to a partner in a breakout room and change one word to a stronger one
Stretch: add a second shape: a river at the base made of a line about water
questions.a: For example: a winding line: the stream giggles down to the sea

questions.q: Why are the top lines of a mountain calligram short?
options: the poet ran out of ideas
the mountain is narrow at the top
questions.a: B) the mountain is narrow at the top. The shape follows the mountain: narrow at the summit, wide at the base.

questions.q: A calligram is a poem that...
questions.a: B) makes a picture with its words
options: makes a picture with its words

questions.q: What is the title of your calligram?
